value.title: Independent native mappers and explicit snapshot storage

value.principles: Functional core/imperative shell. Six mapper owners and one storage owner use frozen raw input/output types, all wave1 independent. PM is sole shared core/catalog/app/lockfile writer. Existing JSONL mappers do not wait for snapshot/SQLite storage.
contracts: Existing SessionAdapter::map receives supplied NativeRecord slices; uses actual LF offsets only for JSONL. Existing TelemetryRecord, MappedBatch, MappingOptions and OTLP writer remain the common output.

New core/snapshot.rs is the actual input contract: SnapshotRef with explicit path/format/session_id, NativeSnapshot{source,revision,records}, raw SnapshotRecord{key,bytes}, MappedSnapshot records+key-based diagnostics. SQLite keys and structural journal ordinals are not byte offsets.

SnapshotLoader reads bounded whole documents/journals/SQLite transaction snapshots. It hashes native raw records into revision; source.session_id is selection for pure mapping, not partial DB query masquerading as complete history. Journal partial tails fail rather than emitting half reconstruction.

VSCode SnapshotAdapter reduces journal operations purely before projecting request/response events; source operations are never exported as chat events. Cursor IDE selection binds composer/bubble keys explicitly and is distinct from transcript mapper and opaque blob support disposition.

Each mapper exports static native DESCRIPTOR; PM registers without worker edits to app/core/catalog. Snapshot descriptors declare no append-only cursor guarantee. Metadata-only omits actual message/tool content; safe diagnostics carry only structural IDs/keys.

Snapshot SDK output includes full-replacement scope/revision manifest, including empty snapshots; consumers can observe deletions by replacement. Cursor checkpoint returned only after writer acceptance. No hidden sink/dedup transaction or final-session claim.

Exact required snapshot record attributes: unisphere.source.adapter = descriptor ID, unisphere.source.path = source.path, unisphere.source.key = native DB key or structural document/journal location, unisphere.source.revision = snapshot.revision, unisphere.source.format = json_document|json_journal|sqlite_key_value, unisphere.source.kind = actual native kind, unisphere.profile.version = "1". Optional unisphere.source.session.id is a verified native selected session ID. unisphere.source.offset MUST be absent for snapshots. PM tk-0009 updates profile docs and collection proof to select the required provenance set by registered source representation; JSONL keeps actual byte offsets.

Loader MUST validate input before I/O, enforce limits during read, and return only NativeSnapshot values for which validate(limits) is Ok. PM snapshot collection service revalidates injected loader output against source and limits before mapping; pure mappers may assume validated bounded input. max_record_bytes bounds raw value bytes, while max_snapshot_bytes bounds native UTF-8 key bytes plus raw value bytes, including a single large key.

PM tk-0009 retains one descriptor+runner registry for JSONL and snapshot variants. Each registration includes its source representation; production provenance regression creates an appropriate real synthetic JSONL/JSON/journal/SQLite fixture per registration, runs actual export, and asserts every emitted native record and snapshot manifest has that descriptor ID. No second metadata-only registry and no snapshot escape from provenance coverage.

value.rationale: Six source dialects and one storage implementation are independently runnable against existing JSONL fakes and actual new snapshot DTOs; no sibling implementation needed. Only shared composition waits.

value.name: Shared native snapshot storage
value.responsibility: Implement real loader-snapshot crate for bounded JSON document, complete LF journal and read-only transactionally consistent SQLite key/value snapshots. No native semantic mapping. Author synthetic file/database boundary regressions and docs/snapshot-loader.md.
value.interface: pub struct FileSnapshotLoader; implements core SnapshotLoader::read_snapshot. Core SnapshotFormat and SnapshotLimits own inputs. Stable SHA256 revision includes all ordered raw keys/bytes; partial records, changed source or oversized snapshot fail safely. SQLite backend read-only/no query mutations; max data limits enforced before unbounded materialization.

value.name: PM full composition
value.responsibility: Integrate new packages, static descriptor/runner registration, snapshot SDK/application/CLI seam, output manifests, architecture policy and actual whole-pipeline proof. Own all shared lockfile/app/core mutations.
value.interface: App composes each mapper/loader/writer and catalog once. Existing JSONL/export behavior retained. Snapshot export emits scoped full-replacement revision manifest and typed records; no persistent sink/exactly-once guarantee. Snapshot source revisions are not append cursors. One typed descriptor+runner registry covers every JSONL/snapshot dialect; PM extends production provenance regression with representation-appropriate real synthetic sources and validates each output record/manifest against descriptor.id. PM owns conditional JSONL-versus-snapshot provenance proof and revalidation of injected snapshot source/limits.

value.note: All seven independent native OMP coders use explicit new full clones; no linked-worktree dispatcher fallback or global settings.
